title: Architecture: Azure E-Commerce Data Platform
description: Cloud-native Azure data platform ingesting from heterogeneous sources (MySQL, MongoDB, HTTP, CSV) through ADF into ADLS Bronze/Silver/Gold layers via Databricks, served via Synapse Serverless SQL to Power BI.

nodes.label: MySQL OLTP
nodes.description: Olist e-commerce tables: orders, items, payments, customers, sellers, geolocation

nodes.label: MongoDB
nodes.description: Product catalog collection with nested category translations

nodes.label: GitHub HTTP API
nodes.description: Category name translations CSV hosted on GitHub

nodes.label: Azure Data Factory
nodes.description: Parameterized Lookup-ForEach pipeline with Self-hosted IR for on-prem sources

nodes.label: Logic App Alerting
nodes.description: WebActivity callback for email notification on pipeline completion/failure

nodes.label: Azure Data Lake Gen2
nodes.description: Bronze (raw CSV/JSON), Silver (cleansed Delta), Gold (Star Schema Delta)

nodes.label: Azure Databricks
nodes.description: PySpark notebooks for Bronze-to-Silver cleansing and Silver-to-Gold Star Schema modeling

nodes.label: Synapse Serverless SQL
nodes.description: OPENROWSET over Delta/Parquet with 19 views (8 dim + 5 fact + 6 BI views)

nodes.label: Power BI
nodes.description: Interactive dashboards for sales, customer behavior, logistics, and payment analysis
